binary_source_basis.kind: installed binaries match public release asset
binary_source_basis.limit: Release-distribution provenance; no independent reproducible-build claim.
binary_source_basis.method: Identify the running app bundle; explicitly select its bundled CLI. Hash both installed binaries and the corresponding files in a read-only mounted release asset. Resolve the release tag in the public source checkout. No app installation, replacement, rebuild, or fixture execution.

workspace_setup_basis.method: The source enumerates the workspace registry, loads workspace.json, and discovers role metadata under .agent-workspaces while preserving existing role order. Opening Bartender status resolves the selected workspace and refreshes its dispatch watcher. Fixture preparation and disabled-provider behavior remain subject to separate approval.
